posts.description: Just a wee update on a few things. I've been playing around with NetBSD recently and that led me to getting it running on the BeagleBoard I found at the EMF swap shop this year. That board is now the latest bit of e-waste that this site is being hosted on. The ESP32 badge served me well, but it's time for a slight upgrade. posts.title: site/A tiny feed reader
posts.description: I've got a very minimal RSS/Atom feed reader running on the badge . It's about 150 lines of micropython, excluding this tiny XML tokeniser called xmltok . It's not even a parser, but feeds are simple enough that it works fine. The feed list is just a text file on the server with one URL per line, that I can already edit in the browser. posts.title: The Weaver web browser
posts.description: I think the world needs more web browsers, so I'm making one. It's an experiment - I want to see if you can take a really simple approach to rendering pages. To set your expectations, this is a browser for the "document-based" web - no javascript, and so no web apps.
